paragraphs: Data Analyst with 3+ years of experience using SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, and advanced analytics across financial, operational, and healthcare data. Experienced in ETL/ELT, data quality, data governance, data modeling, data pipelines, KPI reporting, and stakeholder collaboration.
